outcomes.CANDIDATE: all validation and confirmation criteria pass -> register S08 criteria for btcusdt-momentum-v2 and run the S08 flow
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: validation passes, confirmation fails, or fewer than 15 trades

validation: closed_trades_per_year <= 30% of the baseline on the same window
costs <= 50% of the gross result (net + costs)

baseline.metrics_same_engine: evaluate the baseline on the development and validation windows with the same code; record net_return_pct, closed_trades, closed_trades_per_year, costs, costs / gross

checkpoints.check: Grid of 12 configurations reproducible from this spec (same ledger digests on two runs); selection computed from development results only, recorded before validation is run.

Report per window (development, validation, confirmation) for baseline and selected configuration: net return, drawdown, trades, trades/year, costs, costs/gross; outcome CANDIDATE / INCONCLUSIVE / REJECTED justified on the criteria above.
If CANDIDATE: config/live/btcusdt-momentum-v2.json and S08 criteria registered (release register-criteria) before any S08 evaluation; else record the closing evidence in the backlog.

spec.hypothesis: The momentum_24h signal carries a gross edge that turnover destroys. A higher entry threshold and a longer holding horizon reduce the number of round trips enough that the net return after costs (fee 0.10% + slippage 0.05% per side) is positive out of sample.

forbidden: BTCUSDT-1h-forward-v1 and any path under data/forward (CP08 reserved)

confirmation.use: one evaluation; window already observed by S08 for the baseline only

validation.use: one evaluation of the selected configuration

origin.deviation: H-turnover: costs exceed the gross result (reports/s09/paper-btcusdt-momentum-v1, reports/s09/drill-c-btcusdt-momentum-v1)
evidence: releases/btcusdt-momentum-v1/fd1153cd/release-card.json: backtest -96.0% (2214 trades, costs 534.8 on 500), paper -91.1% (1556 trades)
S08-HANDOFF.yaml anomalies: same candidate without costs +40.5% (3559 trades, drawdown -29.3%), diagnostic not preregistered

spec.prompt: Lavora esclusivamente sull'esperimento S09-E01 del repository Crypto Decision Lab. Leggi Crypto_Decision_Lab_PRD.md, S08-HANDOFF.yaml, S09-HANDOFF.yaml e questa specifica (config/experiments/S09-E01-turnover-reduction-v1.json); verifica che il suo sha256 coincida con quello registrato nel backlog. Usa solo BTCUSDT-1h-raw-v1 tramite il catalogo; non leggere data/forward. Valuta la baseline e le 12 configurazioni della griglia sulla finestra di sviluppo con il motore S03 e i gap riconosciuti come in release.evaluate_backtest; registra in un file versionato la configurazione selezionata con la regola di selezione PRIMA di eseguire validazione e conferma; poi valuta una sola volta baseline e selezionata su validazione e conferma. Calcola le metriche dichiarate, applica i criteri di accettazione e motiva l'esito CANDIDATE, INCONCLUSIVE o REJECTED. Esegui CP-E01.1-3 e restituisci per ciascuno comando, atteso, osservato ed evidenza nel formato di handoff del PRD; aggiorna la riga E01 del backlog.
spec.selection_rule: On development only: among configurations with closed_trades >= 30, the highest net_return_pct; ties -> fewer closed trades. No choice may use validation or confirmation results.
threats: CP08 robustness studies already explored momentum parameters on this snapshot: selection bias is possible; the confirmation window and a later lab/testnet paper session are the guard.
The confirmation window was seen by S08 for the baseline; it is used once and never for selection.
